visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair, wearing a white knit sleeveless top and golden hoop earrings, sits in a warm-lit indoor space. She looks directly at the camera, talking with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. Behind her is a dark wooden wall and a blurred doorway. (2) Cut to a man sitting at a computer desk; his face is completely obscured by a cartoon bear emoji. He wears a dark polo shirt and sits in front of a white mechanical keyboard and a gaming mouse. A small figurine of Goku from Dragon Ball is visible on the desk. (3) The woman continues speaking, emphasizing her points with her right hand. (4) Transition to a graphic animation sequence featuring a stylized cartoon avatar of the woman walking along a blurred city street background. She encounters a cartoon elderly woman carrying a large purple bundle on her back. (5) Transition to a screen recording of a mobile messaging app (Line) showing a chat history between the woman and 'Old Lady'. Icons for phone and video calls are visible at the top. (6) Cut to the man at the desk opening a wooden drawer and pulling out a white cardboard box for an iPhone. He holds it up to the camera. (7) The woman holds a real dark blue iPhone 14/15 Pro, pointing to the cameras on the back. (8) A fast-paced montage of a website interface for '昕顏生技' (hsinyen) appears, showcasing various health supplement products like jelly packs and promotional banners with price drops. (9) The woman reappears in a circle overlay while the man unboxes the iPhone. The video ends with a selfie-style shot of the man holding the phone while the woman speaks from off-camera.

The audio is crisp with minimal background noise. (2) A male voice responds briefly, followed by a bright 'ding' sound effect that punctuates the dialogue shift. (3) The female voice continues the narrative, her speech rate increasing as she recounts a story. The BGM shifts to a more rhythmic pop track with a light drum beat. (4) A 'whoosh' transition SFX is heard as the visual shifts to animation. (5) A series of 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects coincide with digital text bubbles appearing on the screen. (6) A sharp mechanical click sounds as a drawer is opened, followed by a thud as a box is placed on a surface. (7) The female voice becomes more energetic and high-pitched during the promotional segment, with the music swelling in volume to match her excitement. (8) The audio concludes with a brief conversational exchange between the two speakers over the fading music track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Storytelling -> Climax -> Narrative Pivot -> Product Introduction -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video starts with a humorous skit about trust in marriage and a miraculous story of a wife receiving an iPhone for helping an elderly lady. This narrative serves as a hook to transition into a direct advertisement for '昕顏生技' (hsinyen). The speaker explains that their website is being updated with price cuts and a lottery where customers can win iPhones and iPads, encouraging viewers to visit the site and make purchases.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The second half of the video is dedicated to showing the company's website, products, and specific promotional details including price drops and prizes.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A typical social media marketing video that uses a narrative skit to engage viewers before delivering a commercial message. The production uses variety-show style subtitles and SFX to maintain high energy.
